tasks.content:
Install the 'marked' library (markdown-to-HTML converter) as a dependency.

Run: npm install marked --prefix apps/flashcards/app

Also install types: npm install @types/marked --save-dev --prefix apps/flashcards/app

Verify package.json is updated with marked in dependencies.

This is needed for the MarkdownEngine implementation.

Update src/components/FlashcardDisplay.tsx to accept CardSide type and render via resolved engine.

Current component renders card.front and card.back as plain strings. Update it to:

1. Import engineRegistry and normalizeCardSide from '@/engine/EngineRegistry'
2. Change the component to accept card with CardSide front/back (already defined in types)
3. Use a ref for the front and back face divs to render via engine
4. Call engine.render() via useEffect when the card or flip state changes

Key implementation:
- Create refs: frontRef and backRef for the target divs
- Resolve engines: const frontEngine = engineRegistry.resolve(normalizeCardSide(card.front).renderEngineId)
- Render front: useEffect that calls frontEngine.render(normalizeCardSide(card.front).data, frontRef.current!)
- Render back: useEffect that calls backEngine.render(normalizeCardSide(card.back).data, backRef.current!)
- The effects should run when card.id or isFlipped changes

Keep the existing flip animation, styling, and keyboard handling intact.
Keep the existing data-testid attributes (flashcard-container, flashcard-front, flashcard-back).

CRITICAL: All existing tests in FlashcardDisplay.test.tsx must pass without modification. The tests pass Card objects with plain string front/back — the normalization helper handles this automatically.

Reference: apps/flashcards/docs/how/sprints/sprint-1-render-engine/sprint.md — sections 3 and 5

Update src/main.tsx to register TextEngine and MarkdownEngine in the engine registry at app startup.

Add these imports:
```typescript
import { engineRegistry } from '@/engine/EngineRegistry'
import { TextEngine } from '@/engine/TextEngine'
import { MarkdownEngine } from '@/engine/MarkdownEngine'
```

Before ReactDOM.createRoot().render(), register the engines:
```typescript
engineRegistry.register('text', TextEngine)
engineRegistry.register('markdown', MarkdownEngine)
```

Keep all existing imports, app setup, and rendering logic intact.

Reference: apps/flashcards/docs/how/sprints/sprint-1-render-engine/sprint.md — section 2 (Engine Registry)

Migrate apps/flashcards/app/src/data/themes/world-capitals.json to the extended CardSide format.

Convert every card from:
```json
{ "id": "card-1", "front": "France", "back": "Paris" }
```
To:
```json
{ "id": "card-1", "front": { "data": "France", "renderEngineId": "text" }, "back": { "data": "Paris", "renderEngineId": "text" } }
```

All 12 cards must be migrated. Both front and back use renderEngineId: 'text'.

Keep the theme id, name, and card ids unchanged.

Reference: apps/flashcards/docs/how/sprints/sprint-1-render-engine/sprint.md — section 6

Migrate apps/flashcards/app/src/data/themes/multiplication-tables.json to the extended CardSide format.

Convert every card from:
```json
{ "id": "mult-1-1", "front": "1 × 1", "back": "1" }
```
To:
```json
{ "id": "mult-1-1", "front": { "data": "1 × 1", "renderEngineId": "text" }, "back": { "data": "1", "renderEngineId": "text" } }
```

All 100 cards must be migrated. Both front and back use renderEngineId: 'text'.

Keep the theme id, name, and card ids unchanged.

Reference: apps/flashcards/docs/how/sprints/sprint-1-render-engine/sprint.md — section 6

Migrate apps/flashcards/app/src/data/themes/conjugaisons-fr.json to the extended CardSide format.

Convert every card:
- front side: use renderEngineId: 'text'
- back side: use renderEngineId: 'markdown' (conjugaison back sides contain multiline content that benefits from markdown rendering)

From:
```json
{ "id": "aimer-present", "front": "Aimer — présent", "back": "j'aime\ntu aimes\n..." }
```
To:
```json
{ "id": "aimer-present", "front": { "data": "Aimer — présent", "renderEngineId": "text" }, "back": { "data": "j'aime\ntu aimes\nil/elle aime\nnous aimons\nvous aimez\nils/elles aiment", "renderEngineId": "markdown" } }
```

All 60 cards must be migrated. Front = 'text', back = 'markdown'.

Keep the theme id, name, and card ids unchanged.

Reference: apps/flashcards/docs/how/sprints/sprint-1-render-engine/sprint.md — section 6
